title.narrative: Maximizing efforts to control and eliminate Malaria in Somalia

description.narrative: Somalia - Malaria - United Nations Children's Fund - UNICEF. This program has the following goals: attain zero malaria death and reduce malaria incidence to at least 0.5/1000 population by 2026. This is to be achieved through four overarching strategic pillars and objectives.. The objectives of this program are: “By 2026, Atleast 95% of population at risk of malaria living in accessible areas are provided with appropriate malaria prevention and case management services”. “By 2026, at least 20 districts shall be reporting zero local transmission of malaria”.. “By 2026, malaria M&E, EPR and surveillance capacity is enhanced to provide the required national strategic information for decision making”.. “By 2026, the enabling environment and systems for malaria response in Somalia are optimally functioning”.
